facts_of_case: The parties were married, but separated in 2015. The husband filed for divorce under the Hindu Marriage Act, which was allowed by the trial court. The wife appealed to this court.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can reconsider and modify settlement agreements in changed circumstances.
legal_principles.held: In view of the changed circumstances and the subsequent developments on account of the demise of the respondent, we had requested learned counsel for the appellant to reconsider the terms of settlement and obtain fresh instructions from his client.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to modify settlement agreements without court intervention.
legal_principles.held: The parties were referred to the Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre. Since the appellant is residing and working in Dubai and she was to travel to Delhi for negotiating a settlement, the learned Mediator was requested to conduct the mediation on a day-to-day basis to facilitate the parties in arriving at a settlement.

outcome.final_order: Settlement agreement reached between parties; appeal adjourned en bloc due to COVID-19 pandemic.

use_for_drafting: using video conferencing for court hearings
